topic: Cleaning session data and forecast adjustments
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on cleaning up historical device session data used for forecasting. Initially, the team discussed removing 'extra' sessions that were found to influence frequency and dwell time calculations. It was decided that the best approach is to delete these extraneous sessions from the main session tables and then re-aggregate the data.

Regarding a specific facility (31807) and company (7847), the team reviewed the forecast logic, confirming that removing certain fake or incorrectly attributed sessions improves the accuracy of the forecast. The start date for the analysis was set to August 15th.
decisions: Extraaneous session data will be deleted from the main session tables and re-aggregated.
The starting date for the facility's analysis (31807) is confirmed as August 15th.
action_items: Re-run the aggregation process after cleaning the session data.
